Add an `export-json` command requiring `--path` and accepting optional `--status pending|completed`. Return a stable text or `--json` summary containing exported count and destination. Reject an invalid status without creating or changing the destination. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/export.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON exports display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `EXPORT`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

+function Write-JsonFileAtomically {
+    param(
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path,
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][AllowEmptyCollection()][object[]]$Value
+    )
+
+    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path
+    if ($parent -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
+        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
+    }
+
+    $temporary = "$Path.$PID.$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')).tmp"
+    try {
+        $json = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($Value) -Depth 8
+        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($temporary, "$json`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+        [System.IO.File]::Move($temporary, $Path, $true)
+    }
+    finally {
+        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $temporary) {
+            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporary -Force
+        }
+    }
+}

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $second = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Second task', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($second.ExitCode -eq 0) 'second add should succeed'
    $third = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Third task', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($third.ExitCode -eq 0) 'third add should succeed'
    $storedTasks = @((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json)
    $storedTasks[1].id = 10
    $storedTasks[2].id = 2
    $storedJson = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $storedTasks -Depth 8
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($dataFile, "$storedJson`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))

    $storageBeforeExport = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($dataFile)
    $exportPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'missing/exports/tasks.json'
    $export = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $exportPath, '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($export.ExitCode -eq 0) 'export-json should succeed'
    $exportSummary = $export.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($exportSummary.exportedCount -eq 3 -and $exportSummary.destination -eq $exportPath) 'export-json should return a stable JSON summary'
    $exportedTasks = @((Get-Content -LiteralPath $exportPath -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($exportedTasks.Count -eq 3 -and $exportedTasks[0].id -eq 1 -and $exportedTasks[1].id -eq 2 -and $exportedTasks[2].id -eq 10) 'export-json should create parent directories and order tasks by numeric ID'
    Assert-True ([System.Linq.Enumerable]::SequenceEqual([byte[]]$storageBeforeExport, [byte[]][System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($dataFile))) 'export-json should not alter task storage'

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($exportPath, "previous destination`n")
    $filtered = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $exportPath, '--status', 'pending', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($filtered.ExitCode -eq 0) 'filtered export-json should replace an existing destination'
    $filteredTasks = @((Get-Content -LiteralPath $exportPath -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($filteredTasks.Count -eq 2 -and @($filteredTasks | Where-Object { $_.status -ne 'pending' }).Count -eq 0) 'filtered export-json should export only matching tasks'
    $bannerLines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/export.txt'))
    Assert-True ($filtered.Output.StartsWith(($bannerLines -join "`n")) -and ($filtered.Output.Split("`n").Count -eq 13)) 'text export should display the banner once before its summary'

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($exportPath, "preserve me`n")
    $invalid = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $exportPath, '--status', 'invalid', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalid.ExitCode -ne 0) 'export-json should reject an invalid status'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $exportPath -Raw) -eq "preserve me`n") 'invalid status should not change an existing destination'
    $invalidMissingPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'must-not-exist/tasks.json'
    $invalidMissing = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $invalidMissingPath, '--status', 'invalid', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidMissing.ExitCode -ne 0 -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Split-Path -Parent $invalidMissingPath))) 'invalid status should not create a destination directory'
    $missingPath = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingPath.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $missingPath.Output.Contains('Missing required option: --path')) 'export-json should require --path'
    $storageBeforeCollision = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($dataFile)
    $collision = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $dataFile, '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($collision.ExitCode -ne 0) 'export-json should reject the task data file as its destination'
    Assert-True ([System.Linq.Enumerable]::SequenceEqual([byte[]]$storageBeforeCollision, [byte[]][System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($dataFile))) 'destination collision should not alter task storage'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'
    $removeSecond = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '2', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($removeSecond.ExitCode -eq 0) 'second remove should succeed'
    $removeTenth = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '10', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($removeTenth.ExitCode -eq 0) 'third remove should succeed'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 28 fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
